s.h: About the Role, Mission or Department Overview
s.t:
As an Engineering Manager for Cybersecurity at The New York Times, you will lead the team responsible for building and operating the platforms, tooling and services that keep our systems secure at scale. Our engineers design and run the infrastructure that underpins vulnerability scanning, secrets management, secure-by-default platforms and other core security capabilities used across the entire technology organization.
You will work with partners in Cybersecurity, Developer Platforms, Enterprise Technology and Product Engineering to deliver reliable, developer-friendly security services. This is a hands-on leadership role where you'll balance people management with technical decision-making. You'll coach engineers, shape technical roadmaps, and help your teams make risk-informed decisions that support both engineering goals and the broader business.
You will report to the Director of Engineering, Cybersecurity within the Information Security organization.
Information Security helps prevent The Times from becoming news. Our department protects the journalists who report the news, the colleagues who support them, the platforms they rely on every day and the readers who depend on our products. We run programs across security engineering, application security, incident response, governance and more, partnering closely with teams throughout the company to keep our systems dependable and safe.

You will lead and grow a Security Engineering team responsible for building and operating core security platforms, including centralized vulnerability management, secrets management, secure CI/CD guardrails, and logging and detection infrastructure.
You will collaborate with Cybersecurity leadership and technical stakeholders across the organization to define the vision, direction, and strategy for the Security Engineering function.
You will own your team's execution and delivery, from roadmap definition through implementation, rollout, and ongoing operations for security services used by engineers across The New York Times.
You will create an environment that favors context over control, empowering engineering teams with the information, patterns, and tooling they need to build and ship secure products and services.
You will partner with Developer Platforms, Enterprise Technology, and Product Engineering teams to design secure-by-default platforms and guardrails that balance security, usability, and performance.
You will establish and improve processes for vulnerability intake, triage, remediation workflows, and reporting that make security risks visible, measurable, and actionable for both engineering teams and leadership.
You will develop and mentor engineers at all levels by providing regular feedback, coaching, and opportunities for growth while helping them set and achieve meaningful career goals.
You will foster a healthy, inclusive team culture built on trust, sustainable engineering practices, and work that is visible, prioritized, and manageable.
You will contribute to department-wide initiatives, including incident response, audit support, and cross-functional working groups focused on a variety of security and engineering topics.
You will champion our values by supporting journalistic independence and demonstrating a strong commitment to The New York Times' mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.

3–5+ years of experience leading engineers as a people manager or tech lead in security engineering, platform engineering, SRE, DevOps, or a related field. Hands-on experience in security engineering and/or infrastructure/platform engineering is also required. A successful candidate will have experience running production workloads in public cloud platforms (AWS and/or GCP), and familiarity with cloud-native security services and guardrails.
Practical experience with modern software delivery practices, such as CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, and container orchestration (e.g., Kubernetes, ECS).
Strong understanding of security controls across key domains, such as identity and access management, encryption, vulnerability management, network security and authentication.
Demonstrated ability to partner with engineering teams to solve complex problems, balancing long-term security posture with near-term delivery needs.
Proven track record of hiring, developing and retaining engineers from diverse backgrounds, and building teams where people do their best work.
Excellent communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical topics to non-specialist audiences and to influence stakeholders at multiple levels.

Experience managing teams that operate central security services such as secrets management (for example, Vault), vulnerability management tooling, or SIEM/logging platforms.
Familiarity with languages and tools like Go, Python, Terraform, Kubernetes, Vault and Wiz.
Experience working in a highly regulated or audit-aware environment, partnering with risk, compliance or legal teams.
Certifications or coursework related to cloud security, security engineering, or people management.

The Opportunity: We are seeking a highly accomplished and dynamic Director, AI & Generative Solutions to join our rapidly expanding team. This pivotal role is designed for a strategic leader with deep technical expertise in Generative AI (GenAI) and advanced AI methodologies , coupled with exceptional client-facing and business development acumen.

You will be instrumental in guiding our diverse client base – from mid-market entities to large corporations – through the complexities of AI technology and business applications, driving innovation from conception to implementation.
This role requires an understanding of AI architecture, model development, and implementation best practices, combined with the ability to articulate complex AI concepts and their strategic implications to both technical and non-technical audiences. You will be a trusted advisor, a thought leader, and a hands-on contributor in crafting bespoke GenAI and agentic solutions that address our clients' most pressing business challenges and unlock new opportunities.

Advanced AI Solution Design & Architecture: Lead the technical design, development, and architecture of cutting-edge AI and Generative AI solutions. This includes selecting appropriate models (LLMs, diffusion models, etc.), designing data pipelines for AI training and inference, and architecting scalable and robust AI systems.
Strategic Client Engagement & Technical Advisory: Serve as a trusted technical advisor to national and international clients, guiding them from strategic planning stages through to the pilot and full-scale implementation of complex AI and GenAI projects. Confidently present and articulate Blend360's technical capabilities and the strategic implications of AI solutions to senior client stakeholders.
Technical Implementation & Oversight: Provide hands-on technical leadership and guidance throughout the entire project lifecycle, from proof-of-concept to pilot and full-scale production deployment. Ensure technical excellence, adherence to best practices, and the delivery of high-quality, performant AI solutions.
Thought Leadership & Innovation: Drive thought leadership in the evolving landscape of GenAI, large language models (LLMs), agentic AI systems, and emerging AI techniques. Research and evaluate new technologies, contribute to internal IP development, and publish insights that position Blend360 at the forefront of AI innovation.
Business Development Support & Technical Scoping: Actively participate in presales activities, providing deep technical expertise for proposal development, solution architecture, and technical scoping. Support the identification and capitalization on new business opportunities by demonstrating our technical capabilities and value proposition.
AI Strategy & Roadmapping: Collaborate with clients to understand their business challenges and translate them into actionable AI strategies and technical roadmaps. Develop bespoke GenAI solutions, facilitate seamless integration, and advise on organizational changes necessary for AI adoption.
Project Leadership & Execution: Lead and manage specific technical workstreams within complex projects, ensuring deliverables meet the strategic goals, technical excellence, and quality standards expected by our clients. Drive cross-functional collaboration with data scientists, machine learning engineers, and other specialists to ensure successful technical outcomes.
Service Evolution & Go-to-Market: Contribute to the continuous development and technical refinement of Blend360's AI and Generative Solutions offerings. Support go-to-market strategies by providing technical insights and expertise for effective positioning in the market.
10+ years of proven experience in technical consulting, solution architecture, or a similar role, with a strong recent focus (at least 5-7 years) on the design, development, and implementation of advanced AI/ML and Generative AI solutions.
Deep and practical technical expertise in Generative AI (GenAI) technologies , including: Large Language Models (LLMs): Architecture (e.g., Transformers), fine-tuning, prompt engineering, RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation), and deployment strategies.
Other Generative Models: Familiarity with diffusion models, GANs, or other generative architectures is a plus.
Agentic AI Systems: Experience in designing and implementing multi-agent systems or autonomous agents.
Proficiency with core AI/ML frameworks and libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, LangChain, LangGraph, Crew.ai or equivalent.
Programming experience in Python, with experience in developing and deploying production-grade AI applications.
Experience with cloud-based AI platforms (e.g., AWS SageMaker, Google Cloud AI Platform, Azure ML) and MLOps practices for scaling and managing AI models.
Demonstrated ability to engage confidently with clients at all levels , translating complex technical concepts into clear business value and articulating technical solutions effectively.
Proven track record in supporting business development , including technical presales, solution architecture for proposals, and identifying new opportunities.
Exceptional strategic consulting abilities , with a knack for translating ambiguous business problems into workable AI/GenAI solutions and developing clear technical roadmaps for implementation.
Strong analytical, architectural, and problem-solving skills , with the ability to navigate complex data environments and design robust technical solutions.
Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills , capable of working effectively with cross-functional technical and business teams.
Ability to lead technical projects and make strategic architectural decisions in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
A strong desire to stay at the cutting edge of AI advancements and continuously learn and apply new technologies.
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a closely related quantitative field. A Ph.D. in a related field is a significant plus.
Why Blend360?
Impactful Technical Work: Be at the forefront of AI innovation, designing and implementing cutting-edge technical solutions for leading companies and making a tangible impact on their businesses.
Growth Opportunities: Thrive in a company and leadership team committed to growth, providing a platform for your technical and professional development.
Collaborative Culture: Work alongside a team of world-class experts in data science, AI, and technology, fostering an environment of learning, sharing, and mutual support on complex technical challenges.
Bold Vision: Join a company that is brave, goes the extra mile to innovate, and delivers bold visions for the future of AI.
If you are a visionary technical leader passionate about leveraging AI and GenAI to drive business transformation and are excited by the prospect of shaping the future of our clients, we encourage you to apply!
